summary_brief: 当日生态围绕三方面集中演进：一是新一代旗舰模型（Claude Sonnet 5.5、Gemini 3.8 Flash）在各 SDK 与框架中密集落地，配套推理强度控制与模型目录发现能力成为标配；二是多代理/多租户场景的并发隔离、身份注入防护与沙箱化安全边界成为高频修复主题，安全从单点升级为系统级设计；三是缓存的成本与性能优化（提示缓存复用、SQLite 回收、热节点复用）方向显著升温，AI 工作负载开始追求可量化的成本与延迟治理。

engineering_signals.title: 新一代旗舰模型（Claude Sonnet 5.5、Gemini 3.8 Flash）多生态快速落地
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Anthropic 发布 Sonnet 5.5（1M 上下文）后，vercel/ai 同步支持该模型及 between_tools 思考类型，@ai-sdk/google-vertex 同步降级处理，同时 Gemini 3.8 Flash 被 CrewAI、openclaw 接入，Sonnet 5.5 被 Anthropic SDK（Java/Python/Go/TS）与 claude-code-action 全面跟进，新一代模型生态链在发布当日即完成多端适配。

engineering_signals.title: 推理强度（reasoning effort）控制在多提供方间补齐能力差异
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 此前 Ollama 提供方忽略 reasoning_effort、xAI 不支持推理摘要，当日 goose、opencode、openai 等多项目分别补齐 Ollama 思考强度透传、xAI reasoning summary 与缓存，使推理型模型的控制粒度跨提供方趋于一致，是模型能力差异收敛的系统性信号。

engineering_signals.title: 多代理/多租户场景下并发隔离与身份注入防护成为安全核心
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: gptme 修复子代理进程级 tool_format 全局污染与 AGENTS.md 身份指令注入，ruflo 实施 ruvector SQL 注入加固与多租户沙箱，microsoft/agent-framework 按沙箱隔离 Foundry 托管状态、fail-closed 审批，opencode 拒绝 Gemini 并行工具调用丢失 provider 元数据——多代理协作正从功能推向身份、状态与凭据的系统级隔离。

engineering_signals.title: 提示缓存复用与成本治理成为 AI 工作负载的核心优化方向
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: opencode 通过移除会话唯一 ID、按跨会话共享度排序指令源，将 OpenAI 冷启动前缀缓存命中率从 17.7% 提升至 45.4%、Anthropic 从 29% 到 59.8%，配合 Anthropic 缓存诊断 GA、codex 后台 SQLite vacuum、openclaw 热节点复用，AI agent 负载正系统性地追求可量化的成本与延迟治理。

engineering_signals.title: Agent 工具调用兼容层开始完整保留厂商专属 provider 元数据
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: opencode 修复 Gemini 通过 OpenAI 兼容接口并行工具调用因丢失 extra_content(thought signature) 而 400 失败，vercel/ai 修复工具名/provider ID 为 __proto__ 的原型污染与 Azure resourceName SSRF——多厂商互操作正要求兼容层不仅转发标准协议，还要完整保留厂商专属元数据并防御注入。

engineering_signals.title: 实时流式（Realtime/WebSocket）可靠性与观测能力集中增强
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: openai-python 连续修复 Realtime 重连消息重放、Live 空队损失消息、新增 detailed_snapshot()，vercel/ai 修复流式重连 URL 编码与 Markdown 表格拆分，cline 为 Hub 关闭增加日志——实时会话的状态一致性、字节预算与可观测性成为多家 SDK 的共同改进焦点。

engineering_signals.title: MCP 生态走向多租户化、OAuth 认证与沙箱安全加固
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: ruflo 推出独立的多租户 AI Team MCP 服务（OAuth 受众/作用域检查、租户隔离、沙箱化不可信数据），openai/codex 支持预注册 OAuth client secret 的 MCP 服务器与 exec-server Bearer token，claude-code 新增 /mcp reconnect all 并加固预授权绕过与符号链接绕过——MCP 正在从工具连接标准演进为需要完整安全边界的服务架构。

engineering_signals.title: Agent 团队协作与任务委派范式加速落地（Leader/Member、hive-mind、handoff）
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: AgentScope 推出 TeamPipeline 让 Leader 委派给 Member 并发执行，ruflo 引入 hive-mind work 消费队列分发任务，opencode 让子会话共享父会话亲和头实现粘性路由，codex Guardian 引入 handoff 感知上下文——多代理协作从概念走向可运行的工程架构与安全审查。

engineering_signals.title: 编译构建层性能与正确性修复密集（Turbopack/Next.js）
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Turbopack 修复 macOS 上递归 watcher 导致的编译挂起、优化无副作用模块求值、修复空 tree-shake chunk 失配，SSR 启用懒加载动态导入，Turborepo 用 usage-rs 替换 clap 减小 CLI——构建工具在正确性与性能之间持续平衡，直接影响所有前端开发者日常体验。

engineering_signals.title: Agent 观测与评测工作流走向标准化与可量化
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Anthropic 将 Opus 5.5/Sonnet 5.5 设为默认并推出 build-eval、eval-hillclimb 指南与报告 schema，phoenix 为 bash 工具错误标记 span、为实验连接加入排序与序号，promptfoo 增加 per-call 用量上报，Agent 评测正从零散脚本走向可复现、可度量的工程体系。

engineering_signals.title: 防护注入攻击成为跨语言 SDK 的共性安全焦点（SSRF/ReDoS/原型污染/终端注入）
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: ruflo 修复 import 解析器指数回溯(ReDoS)，vercel/ai 修复 Azure SSRF、原型污染与 TUI 控制字符注入，agent-framework 修复 Foundry 请求头 NUL 与来源劫持，codex 防凭据进沙箱策略日志——各类注入向量在 agent/工具链路径上被系统性地封堵，反映供应链安全意识的集体提升。

engineering_signals.title: 会话界面可迁移与旁路交互改善长任务体验
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: gptme 新增 /restart 让会话在 CLI/TUI/Web 间无缝切换，deepagents 新增隔离式 /btw 旁路提问与 ask_for_help 专家咨询，AgentScope 推出全屏终端 TUI——交互层为长任务提供不打断主上下文的旁路通道与界面自由度，是 agent UX 成熟度的标志。

release_signals.title: Claude Sonnet 5.5 发布
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新一代默认 Sonnet 模型，提供 1M 上下文窗口和更优的性价比，是 Anthropic 模型能力的一次重要升级，影响所有使用 Anthropic API 和 Claude Code 的用户。

release_signals.title: AgentScope 引入标准操作流程
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增 agentscope.sop 模块，将复杂任务分解为有序、可验证的里程碑，并支持状态持久化和恢复，为构建可靠的多步骤 Agent 工作流提供了新的抽象。

release_signals.title: AgentScope 推出团队协作模式
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增 TeamPipeline 类，支持 Leader 代理将任务委派给多个 Member 代理并发执行，是向更复杂、更真实的 Agent 协作范式迈进的重要一步。

release_signals.title: AgentScope 扩展实时语音模型支持
release_signals.why_it_matters: 实时语音 Agent 新增对 OpenAI Realtime、Gemini Live 和 xAI Grok Voice 的支持，显著扩展了多模态交互的生态兼容性。

release_signals.title: OpenAI Codex 增强 MCP 与安全
release_signals.why_it_matters: 支持需要预注册 OAuth client secret 的 MCP 服务器，并为 exec-server WebSocket 连接引入 Bearer token 认证，提升了 Agent 生态的集成能力和安全性。

release_signals.title: CrewAI 支持 Gemini 3.8 Flash
release_signals.why_it_matters: 原生支持最新的 Gemini 3.8 Flash 模型，使 CrewAI 用户能够利用该模型的能力，保持框架与前沿模型同步。

release_signals.title: LangChain 支持 Bedrock Mantle 模型
release_signals.why_it_matters: init_chat_model 新增对 Bedrock Mantle 系列模型的支持，简化了在 AWS 生态中使用新模型的过程。

release_signals.title: DeepAgents 引入隔离式提问功能
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增 /btw 命令，允许用户在不打断主任务上下文的情况下提出独立的旁路问题，优化了人机交互工作流。

release_signals.title: Turborepo 重构 CLI 与依赖
release_signals.why_it_matters: 使用 usage-rs 替换 clap、升级 serde_json 和 Ratatui 等核心依赖，旨在减小 CLI 体积、降低内存分配并提升整体性能。

release_signals.title: Claude Code 强化安全与权限控制
release_signals.why_it_matters: 修复了插件工具预授权绕过、外部符号链接规则绕过等安全漏洞，并改进了沙箱命令的权限检查，提升了整体安全性。

release_signals.title: Claude Code 优化 MCP 连接与工作流
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增 /mcp reconnect all 命令，并修复了 MCP 工具调用在服务器连接期间的失败问题，显著提升了 MCP 集成的稳定性和易用性。

release_signals.title: OpenAI SDK 支持增量快照
release_signals.why_it_matters: Responses API 支持 WebSocket 文本和工具快照的增量更新，为构建低延迟的实时交互应用提供了更高效的基础能力。

release_signals.title: Anthropic SDK 支持缓存诊断
release_signals.why_it_matters: 缓存诊断功能正式可用（GA），允许开发者在 Message 请求中获取更详细的缓存信息，有助于优化成本和性能。

release_signals.title: AgentScope 引入终端 UI 与模型路由
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增全屏终端聊天界面 agentscope.tui 和基于 Jev 的 ModelRouterMiddleware，提升了交互体验和模型调度的灵活性。

release_signals.title: vercel/ai 批量发版 322 个子包（4 个值得注意）
release_signals.why_it_matters: vercel/ai monorepo 当日批量发布 322 个子包，其中绝大多数为 changesets 例行依赖同步（Patch 级、仅更新依赖）。真正有实质变更的仅有数处新能力补充：新增 Claude Sonnet 5.5 模型及 between_tools 思考类型支持、@ai-sdk/azure 新增 MAI-Transcribe-2 文件转写能力、provider 图像模型文件/mask 输入能力声明增强，以及少量 bug 修复。本批发版不含任何 breaking changes，属非纯同步但风险可控的能力增强型发布。

release_signals.title: vercel/ai @ai-sdk/anthropic@4.0.68
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增 Claude Sonnet 5.5 模型 ID 及新的 between_tools 思考类型，属于主要新能力补充

release_signals.title: vercel/ai @ai-sdk/azure@4.0.83
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增 MAI-Transcribe-2 文件转写能力，通过 Azure Speech API 实现，支持说话人分离与时间戳等

release_signals.title: vercel/ai @ai-sdk/google-vertex@5.0.982
release_signals.why_it_matters: 同步获得 Claude Sonnet 5.5 模型支持，含 between_tools 思考类型及对禁用思考/强制工具使用的自动降级处理

release_signals.title: vercel/ai @ai-sdk/harness@1.0.129
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增 HarnessAgent 的 workDir 灵活设置，并修复运行时上下文向回调与遥测的转发

releases.author: ashwin-ant
releases.summary:
## What's changed

- Added Claude Sonnet 5.5 (`claude-sonnet-5-5`), now the default Sonnet model on the Anthropic API — 1M context, $2/$10 per Mtok with $0.20/Mtok cache reads
- Added a "Yes, but ask again next time" answer to auto mode's prompt before a read outside the working directories, so you can allow that one read and still be asked about later ones
- Added dollar amounts to the Claude apps gateway spend limit in `/usage` and the status line (for example "$271.40 / $500.00 spent this month") when the gateway runs this version or later; the status line's `rate_limits.spend_limit` also gains `used_usd`, `limit_usd` and `period`
- Added `effortSlider:decreaseEffort`, `increaseEffort` and `toggleUltracode` keybinding actions, so the `/effort` slider's arrow and Tab keys can be rebound in `keybindings.json`
- Added `/rate-limit-options` to `/help` and the command menu for claude.ai subscribers, so the usage-limit notices that mention it point to a command you can find
- Added `/mcp reconnect all` in the interactive terminal to retry every MCP server that failed to connect or needs authentication at once
- Added Claude apps gateway startup warnings when a managed policy's `availableModels` is empty, or leaves out the model Claude Code starts on without setting `model` or `enforceAvailableModels`
- Added `auth: { google: {} }` for Claude apps gateway `telemetry.forward_to` destinations, so telemetry can be exported straight to Google Cloud's OTLP endpoint using the gateway's Google Cloud credentials
- Added certificate client authentication (`private_key_jwt`) between the Claude apps gateway and its identity provider, for identity providers that issue certificate credentials instead of client secrets
- Fixed a damaged response stream showing raw errors such as "JSON Parse error" or "undefined is not an object", or writing the word "undefined" into an answer, instead of being retried or reported as an interrupted response
- Fixed an overloaded or server error arriving right after a thinking block ending the turn with an error instead of being retried
- Fixed "Prompt is too long" errors that persisted after compacting: when the compacted request is still too long, Claude Code now compacts once more, keeping less of the recent conversation
- Fixed a session whose model is unavailable, with no fallback model left, showing a bare "is currently unavailable" message (or "Something went wrong" in cloud sessions) instead of the model-unavailable notice and its Learn more link
- Fixed Agent SDK sessions crashing when a user message contains an image with a malformed `source`, and failing on every later turn after a malformed document block; a malformed image is now replaced with an explanatory note
- Fixed MCP tool calls in a resumed session failing with "No such tool available" while their server was still connecting; the call now waits up to 10 seconds for the server
- Fixed repeated calls to the plan-usage endpoint after it rate-limits or rejects your login: `/usage`, `/extra-usage` and IDE usage views now back off instead of re-asking
- Fixed `claude mcp add` reporting success when managed settings restrict MCP servers to plugins; it now refuses and says what to do, instead of saving a server that never loads
- Fixed the `/plugin` configure screen: boolean options are now a true/false choice instead of free text, number options refuse invalid input, and ←/→ change an options field instead of switching tabs
- Fixed `ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_RESOURCE` being interpolated into the Foundry endpoint host unvalidated; a value that is not a plain resource name is now refused
- Fixed Claude Desktop behind a Claude apps gateway offering no 1M context option: the gateway now marks each 1M-capable model for Desktop automatically
- Fixed ↓ in shell mode selecting a hidden background-tasks pill, which stopped Backspace and Ctrl+U from editing the prompt
- Fixed Bash tool failing on Windows with many plugins enabled: plugin `bin/` directories that don't exist are no longer added to PATH, and inherited entries aren't added twice
- Fixed `sparsePaths` plugin marketplaces cloning empty and replacing a working local copy on older git (before 2.39), which failed every refresh with "marketplace.json file is no longer present"
- Fixed fullscreen rendering erasing the terminal output above the session when `[` in transcript mode writes the conversation to scrollback (macOS and Linux)
- Fixed fullscreen scroll position jumping to the previous message or to the bottom when a reply finished streaming while scrolled up
- Fixed tab bars in dialogs such as `/config` and `/plugin` breaking the title and tab labels mid-word in a narrow terminal; a tab that doesn't fit now moves to the next line whole
- Fixed the `/model` picker showing "+1 model" below the list after scrolling to the last model; the count now covers only the models below the visible rows
- Fixed `/keybindings` writing Backspace and Delete bindings for a footer action that does nothing into the generated `keybindings.json`
- Fixed a rebound agent panel close key (`footer:close`) typing "x" instead of itself on the row of the agent you're viewing
- Fixed vim mode `.` not repeating text typed very fast (for example over ssh or in tmux) or pasted without bracketed paste, and leaving the prompt in INSERT mode after repeating a change with nothing typed (such as `cw` then Esc)
- Fixed vim mode leaving the cursor on an image placeholder's opening bracket after `dd` on the last line or `yy` at the end of the prompt, where `r` or `x` would break or delete the image
- Fixed a key pressed the instant the terminal regained focus answering the Remote Control enable prompt before its short safety delay restarted
- Fixed the workspace trust dialog appearing a second time after switching renderers or updating when Claude Code was started in the home directory
- Fixed rules symlinked into `.claude/rules` from outside the project being skipped without ever showing the external-imports approval prompt; a `.claude` directory symlinked from outside the project now asks for the same approval
- Fixed plugins from marketplaces, claude.ai and npm pre-approving their own tools via `allowed-tools` under managed `allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly`; only plugins from an official Anthropic source or a source that managed settings vouch for keep that pre-approval
- Fixed a failed first `claude plugin install` leaving the plugin enabled and recorded when a dependency's version range could not be met
- Fixed the debug log dropping a failed hook's stderr when the hook also wrote to stdout, and logging nothing for a failed hook with no output; failed hooks now also log their status code
- Fixed `{"decision":"block"}` returned by Elicitation and ElicitationResult hooks being ignored; it now declines the MCP elicitation, as exit code 2 does
- Fixed sessions launched without the `SendMessage` tool (such as by Claude Desktop) still being told to message other sessions with it
- Fixed a photo sent from the Claude app over Remote Control being lost when its queued message was pulled back into the terminal prompt to edit, and the cursor moving one character for a photo with no caption
- Fixed typing a message during an automatic usage-limit wait taking the wait out of the "Continue automatically at usage limit" setting's control when that turn hit the limit again
- Fixed usage-limit warnings suggesting `/upgrade` to users already on the highest Max plan; the warnings and `/upgrade` itself now point at `/usage-credits` when it is available
- Fixed the Explore subagent switching to Opus on the Claude API when the session runs a model ID Claude Code doesn't recognize, such as a custom model behind a proxy; Explore now inherits that model
- Fixed `/loop` status updates in self-paced mode often not being shown because Claude wrote them only in its reasoning; Claude now writes each update, and the outcome when the loop stops, as visible text
- Fixed `/ultrareview` failing to upload the working tree when started from a git worktree that the Claude desktop app created on macOS or Linux
- Fixed sandboxed Bash commands failing to start on Linux when the working directory is write-denied and contains a read-denied directory
- Fixed artifact database write results telling Claude that every viewer sees a write to a viewer's private `data/users/` subtree, and added a "view" level to `as_level`
- Fixed the Claude apps gateway answering `431 Request Header Fields Too Large` to every request from a sign-in whose identity provider lists many groups; it now accepts request headers up to 256 KiB
- Improved the usage-limit wait: the limit's state and the countdown with the usage-credits option now show as one block under the prompt, and limit messages no longer repeat the countdown
- Improved the "No such tool available" error for Claude in Chrome tools called without their prefix: it now names the tool to call
- Improved Monitor event rows to show what each event printed instead of repeating the description, and stopped repeating an unchanged "Waiting for N … to finish" line after every event
- Improved Workflow tool sandbox hardening for errors thrown by async script hooks
- Improved startup time and memory use by building only the parts of the settings schema that your settings files actually use
- Improved `/claude-api`: `hillclimb` no longer spends rounds on prompt rewordings too small for the eval to measure, and an extra page you ask for beside `report.html` is built as one local file that loads nothing from the network
- Improved lists such as `/tasks`, `/copy` and `/hooks`: the details after each name now line up in one column when they fit, and otherwise sit at the right edge
- Improved `claude plugin marketplace add` to say when it replaces a marketplace already added under the same name from a different source, and how to undo it
- Improved the startup refusal when managed settings require a sign-in (`forceLoginMethod` or `forceLoginOrgUUID`) and an API key, token or `apiKeyHelper` is configured: it now names the credential in use, where it is set, and how to remove it
- Improved auto-memory loading: invisible characters and tags that imitate Claude Code's own markup are neutralized in `MEMORY.md` and recalled memory notes before they reach Claude
- Improved `claude remote-control`: in a folder you haven't trusted yet, it now asks for workspace trust on the terminal instead of exiting
- Improved artifact pages: Claude writes its design plan into the page instead of the reply, and uses the name you already gave something as the page title
- Improved the Artifact tool so that when Claude is given a claude.ai chat or project link, an artifact from a chat, or an artifact id on its own, it asks for the right link or the content instead of stopping
- Changed interactive terminal and VS Code sessions to start in auto mode when no permission mode is configured, on every plan and provider; `permissions.defaultMode` still overrides it
- Changed Ultracode into its own toggle in `/effort` (Tab, or `/effort ultracode [on|off]`): it no longer forces xhigh effort and stays on at any effort level
- Changed retries after a dropped connection mid-response to share one budget with the rest of the request's retries, so a failing request gives up sooner
- Changed the notice shown when a Sonnet model's safeguards flag a message to explain why it happened and to offer editing and retrying
- Changed safety-related model switches in sessions that pin an Opus model with `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL` or `modelOverrides`: on the Anthropic API, the API now picks the model to switch to for each kind of flag, not the pinned model
- Changed the non-interactive first turn to still wait up to 2s for connecting MCP servers named by `--allowedTools` or an `mcp_tool` hook, even when `CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_STARTUP_WAIT_MS` is `0`
- Changed `/recap` to decline with a short notice when it arrives relayed from a chat thread (your own included) or from a routine or webhook; typed in the terminal, the Claude apps, Remote Control, `-p` or an SDK host, it runs as before
- Changed `/artifacts` to show its filter tabs beside the title with one-word labels (All, Mine, Shared), using the same tab bar as `/config` and `/plugin`
- Changed artifact publishing to refuse a file on a network share (a `\\host\share` path or a `/net` automount) unless it is on a mapped network drive added with `--add-dir`
- [VSCode] Added an optional time above each prompt and response, with a date line where the day changes (Claude Code: Show Message Timestamps setting, off by default)
- [VSCode] Added plugin load errors and notes to the Manage plugins rows, with a popup to disable, uninstall or copy the error
- [VSCode] Added an Ultracode on/off switch under the Effort slider, replacing the slider's Ultracode stop; the model pill shows "· Ultracode" at any effort level
- [VSCode] Fixed Reload Claude from the Memory dialog restarting before an edited file was saved
- [VSCode] Fixed a restored tab opening a conversation another Claude process still has open; it now asks first
- [VSCode] Fixed Focus view sections you expanded closing on their own while a sub-agent is working or when the section's first step is trimmed from view
- [VSCode] Fixed typing `/model` and Enter printing usage text into the chat instead of opening the model selector
- [VSCode] Fixed `/feedback` on Vertex, Bedrock and Foundry being refused after you pressed Send; the report is now saved on this computer, as the terminal does
- [VSCode] Fixed sign-in waiting up to a minute for the Python extension after a window reload
- [VSCode] Fixed Claude Code tabs that stopped responding after Restart Extensions: they now reopen on their conversation
- [VSCode] Fixed a message from another agent with no recorded sender showing as raw XML in the chat
- [VSCode] Fixed messages from other agents, sessions or channels disappearing after a reload
- [VSCode] Fixed a user's own `/mcp`, `/config` or `/settings` command being shadowed by the extension's dialog
- [VSCode] Fixed Escape stopping every background agent when no turn was running
- [VSCode] Fixed plugin install links replacing a marketplace you already have that uses the same name
- [VSCode] Fixed "Prompt is too long" errors after compaction when a large text file is attached to a message
- [VSCode] Fixed chat links to files with non-ASCII characters, spaces or brackets in their path not opening
- [VSCode] Changed `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` in the `claudeCode.environmentVariables` setting to apply only when it is an absolute path, and passed it to terminals that continue the chat
- [Cloud sessions] Fixed a routine's Edit and Duplicate controls saying the routine was still loading while you were offline; they now tell you you're offline
- [Claude Tag] Added model family choices such as "Opus (latest)" for a thread, a channel default or your DM, so the choice follows the newest model in that family
- [Claude Tag] Added the spend that counts toward your organization-wide limit to the analytics spend projection chart, with how much of the limit is used
- [Claude Tag] Fixed the earlier Claude in Slack app's progress card and link previews omitting the repository and Create PR button when a GitHub Enterprise host name contains an underscore
- [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude staying silent in a channel whose environment declines to start it; it now posts one notice asking you to contact an admin, and retries when @-mentioned
- [Claude Tag] Changed Claude to post its private sign-in notice at every @mention from someone who hasn't connected their Claude account, instead of going quiet after the first
- [Claude Tag] Improved "Notify members now" in admin settings: one press reaches every workspace your organization claimed in an Enterprise Grid, and more members in large workspaces
- [Claude Tag] Improved Claude's wait notice on self-hosted environments with on-demand runners: it now says whether a runner is starting, a start will be retried, or no runner will start
- [Claude Tag] Improved the error shown when adding a channel manager fails because the channel's Slack workspace can't be confirmed as connected to your organization
- [Claude Tag] Improved a channel's access lists in admin settings to show the connectors, repositories and plugins an auto-join pattern attaches, and where each comes from
- [Claude Tag] Improved adding repositories as a channel manager: when your GitHub sign-in can't confirm you're a repository admin, the page asks you to sign in with GitHub
- [Code Review] Fixed Code Review giving up without posting a finished review when an unsubmitted review under its GitHub App was open on the pull request; it now retries the post first

releases.summary:
## What's changed

- Added a renamed skill's directory name to its `SlashCommand` `aliases` when the name is plain and Claude Code ships no command by that name
- Added `applied.ultracodeAvailable` and `applied.ultracodeRequested` to `getSettings()`: whether this session can run Ultracode, and whether it is requested, independent of whether it is in effect
- Fixed `forkSession()` copies reading back the wrong history when cut at a progress row or fork briefing after a rewind, or when the session was compacted with some messages kept
- Fixed `getSessionMessages()` leaving out messages from other agents, sessions and channels that the CLI transcript shows
- Fixed `{ decision: 'block' }` returned by Elicitation and ElicitationResult hook callbacks being ignored; it now declines the MCP elicitation
- Fixed `query()` closing stdin before a follow-up turn woken by a finished background agent, which failed that turn's hooks, `canUseTool` and SDK MCP calls with "Stream closed"
- Changed the first turn to still wait up to 2s for connecting MCP servers named in `allowedTools` or by an `mcp_tool` hook, even with `CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_STARTUP_WAIT_MS` set to `0`
- Changed `applyFlagSettings({ ultracode: true })` to keep the current effort level instead of switching to `xhigh`; an `effortLevel` that changes the level without `ultracode` turns Ultracode off
- Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.284

## Update

```sh
npm install @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk@0.3.284
# or
yarn add @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk@0.3.284
# or
pnpm add @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk@0.3.284
# or
bun add @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk@0.3.284
```

key_changes: 新增 `getSettings()` 中的 `applied.ultracodeAvailable` 和 `applied.ultracodeRequested` 字段，用于反映会话的 Ultracode 可用性和请求状态
修复 `forkSession()` 在查看回退后的进度行或 fork 简报时读取错误历史的问题，以及会话压缩后部分消息被跳过的问题
修复 `getSessionMessages()` 遗漏来自其他代理、会话和通道消息的问题，确保与 CLI 转录一致
修复 Elicitation 钩子回调返回 `block` 被忽略的问题，现在会正确拒绝 MCP 提交流程，并修复 `query()` 在后台代理完成后的流关闭问题
调整 Ultracode 相关行为：`applyFlagSettings({ ultracode: true })` 不再切换 effort 级别；首轮启动时即使将 `CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_STARTUP_WAIT_MS` 设为 0 仍会等待最多 2 秒连接 MCP 服务器
ai_summary.summary_cn: 此版本主要聚焦于多个 Bug 修复和功能增强，包含大量对 SlashCommand 别名、会话历史读取、消息完整性、筛选钩子和流关闭等问题的修复。同时增强了 Ultracode 相关的设置字段和配置行为，并同步更新至与 Claude Code v2.1.284 的功能对齐。

releases.summary:
## Highlight
- **Standard Operating Procedures (Experimental)**: Added the `agentscope.sop` module for splitting a task into ordered milestones, each verified before the next one starts, with run state that can be persisted and resumed. The agent service also exposes `/sop` endpoints to store procedures, start runs, and review steps by hand.
- **Team Pipeline**: Added a `TeamPipeline` class where a leader agent delegates tasks to member agents, which run concurrently and hand their results back.
- **More Realtime Voice Models**: Added OpenAI Realtime, Gemini Live, and xAI Grok Voice models to the realtime voice agent.
- **Terminal UI**: Introduced the `agentscope.tui` module, a full-screen terminal interface for chatting with agents and running realtime voice sessions via `launch_realtime_ui`.
- **AskUser Tool**: Added `AskUser`, an external tool that lets agents ask users multiple-choice questions.
- **MiniMax Model and Jev-based Model Routing**: Added the MiniMax chat model (M3 by default), and a `ModelRouterMiddleware` backed by the new `agentscope.classifier` module (with Jev support) that picks the chat model for each reply.
- **DingTalk Knowledge Base Tools**: Agents on DingTalk channels can now search DingTalk knowledge bases.
- **Safer Shell Permission Checks**: Tightened read-only command detection so destructive `git`, `sed`, and `tee` usages no longer skip permission confirmation.

* feat(realtime): support xAI Grok voice API model by @DavdGao in https://github.com/agentscope-ai/agentscope/pull/2553

key_changes: 新增 Standard Operating Procedures（实验性）模块，可将任务拆分为有序里程碑，支持运行状态持久化与恢复，并提供 /sop 服务端点
新增 TeamPipeline 类，支持领导者代理将任务委派给多个成员代理并行执行
实时语音智能体新增支持 OpenAI Realtime、Gemini Live 和 xAI Grok Voice 模型
新增 agentscope.tui 模块及 launch_realtime_ui 终端全屏聊天界面，并新增 AskUser 外部工具支持多选提问
新增 MiniMax 聊天模型（M3 默认）及 ModelRouterMiddleware 模型路由中间件（支持 Jev 分类器），同时加强了 shell 权限安全检查，破坏性 git/sed/tee 命令不再绕过权限确认
新增钉钉知识库搜索工具、多个模型卡片（qwen3-7b、llama3.2、phi4-mini 等）及大量修复（RAG 解析、实时连接、格式化器、工具验证等）
ai_summary.summary_cn: AgentScope v2.0.9 是一个功能丰富的版本，重点引入标准操作规程（SOP）和 TeamPipeline 团队协作机制，同时为实时语音智能体增加了多个新模型支持，并新增了 TUI 终端界面和 AskUser 工具。此外还加强了 shell 命令权限安全验证，保护用户免受破坏性命令的误执行，并修复了大量 RAG 解析、实时连接、模型格式化等方面的问题。

releases.summary:
## New Features

- Configure copy-on-select and right-click paste in the fullscreen TUI. Copied transcript selections now preserve Markdown formatting. (#47639, #47896, #48118)
- Connect to MCP servers that require pre-registered OAuth client secrets, including through `codex mcp add --oauth-client-secret`. (#47891)
- Secure direct exec-server WebSocket connections with bearer tokens, including connections configured through app-server. (#47601, #47648)
- Image generation and editing can explicitly request transparent backgrounds, and edits now accept file-backed conversation images. (#47484, #47956)
- Terminal input approval is enabled by default for commands running with elevated permissions; runtime-only grants no longer cause unnecessary reviews. (#47799, #48073)

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed Windows sandbox failures involving ordinary Windows 10 paths, rejected stored credentials, and large permission policies. (#47672, #47695, #47919)
- Fixed Linux sandbox startup with nested writable roots and preserved Git metadata protections across writable roots on Linux and macOS. (#47623, #47974)
- macOS patch operations now recognize system path aliases covered by existing permissions, avoiding unnecessary approval prompts. (#47879)
- Approval reviews now retry when new user input arrives, so a status question does not automatically abort a pending action. (#47819)
- Mermaid flowcharts now render quoted labels and ampersands; unsupported diagrams explain why they fall back to source. (#47572, #47678)
- Command completion events now include early output and report process-launch failures to clients. (#47529, #47665)

releases.summary:
## Stable internal packages
The internal `@claude-flow/*` packages are off the alpha line. Everything `npx ruflo@3.48.0` installs now resolves to a single stable version:

| Package | Version |
|---|---|
| `@claude-flow/cli-core` | 3.7.0 |
| `@claude-flow/memory`, `neural`, `shared`, `security`, `mcp` (and the other internal leaves) | 3.0.0 |
| `@claude-flow/plugin-agent-federation`, `plugin-iot-cognitum` | 1.0.0 |

`@claude-flow/embeddings` stays on its alpha line for now.

## Also in this release
- **Guarded public federation registration** (first shipped in 3.47.0 from a release branch) is now on `main`, so this release keeps it.
- **SQL-injection hardening** in the `@claude-flow/plugins` ruvector attention SQL builders. Follow-up for `gnn.ts`: #3531.
- **Smaller, cleaner leaf tarballs.** A `files` allowlist on every leaf stops local runtime state (logs, pids, `settings.json`) from being packed. The three affected alpha versions are deprecated.

PR: #3530

provider 能力声明增强：确认模型 ID 声明、异步能力查询、middleware 覆盖，新增 QuiverAI Arrow 2/Telos 文件输入与 Together FLUX.2 单图编辑声明
harness 系列改进：允许设置 workDir 为 '.' 使用沙箱默认目录、转发运行时上下文到回调和遥测
修复流式工具调用 ID 缺失/重复问题，客户端断开时取消响应流，跨环境流完成异常处理
ai_summary.summary_cn: vercel/ai monorepo 当日批量发布 322 个子包，其中绝大多数为 changesets 例行依赖同步（Patch 级、仅更新依赖）。真正有实质变更的仅有数处新能力补充：新增 Claude Sonnet 5.5 模型及 between_tools 思考类型支持、@ai-sdk/azure 新增 MAI-Transcribe-2 文件转写能力、provider 图像模型文件/mask 输入能力声明增强，以及少量 bug 修复。本批发版不含任何 breaking changes，属非纯同步但风险可控的能力增强型发布。

key_changes: 新增在 turbo npm 包中捆绑文档、发布独立版本化 turbo 归档文件及 curl|bash 安装脚本支持
修复多个稳定性问题：远程产物请求故障退避、pnpm 锁文件哈希稳定化、TUI 日志流恢复、本地缓存写入后磁盘产物签名等
安全修复：升级 js-yaml 修复 CVE-2026-84375，升级 Next.js 修复 CVE-2026-94545，移除不再维护的 proc-macro-error2 依赖
大量测试重构：将多项测试用例迁移至工程契约，优化 CI 构建效率（Go 缓存精简、Cargo 构建复用等）
性能优化：升级 serde_json 减小 CLI 体积、Ratatui 降低 TUI 分配、避免 Bun 锁文件解析时格式化、GraphiQL 页面静态化等
代码重构与依赖清理：用 usage-rs 替代 clap、human-panic 替换为本地崩溃报告、移除多个未使用依赖和死代码
ai_summary.summary_cn: Turborepo v2.11.5 是一次以提高稳定性、安全性和开发体验为重点的改进版本。该版本新增了文档捆绑、独立版本化归档和 curl|bash 安装方式，同时修复了多项稳定性问题并针对已知安全漏洞（CVE-2026-84375、CVE-2026-94545）进行了依赖升级。此外，大量测试用例被重构到工程契约中，并对 CLI 性能和代码质量进行了全面优化。

changes.description: 交互式终端和 VS Code 会话在未配置权限模式时，默认从 acceptEdits 模式改为自动模式（auto mode），影响所有计划和提供商
Ultracode 不再强制 xhigh 努力级别，变为独立开关，可在任何努力级别下开启，改变了原有行为
状态行 rate_limits.spend_limit 新增 used_usd、limit_usd 和 period 字段，可能影响依赖旧字段结构的解析逻辑
插件市场插件、claude.ai 和 npm 插件在 managed allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly 下不再预授权自己的工具，仅官方 Anthropic 来源或受信任来源保留此权限
claude mcp add 在托管设置限制 MCP 服务器仅限插件时，现在拒绝保存并提示，不再报告成功
ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_RESOURCE 环境变量值现在必须为普通资源名称，否则被拒绝，不再进行未经验证的插值
会话固定 Opus 模型（ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL 或 modelOverrides）时，安全相关的模型切换改为由 API 选择，不再使用固定模型
非交互式首轮即使 CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_STARTUP_WAIT_MS 设为 0，仍会等待最多 2 秒以连接 --allowedTools 或 mcp_tool 钩子指定的 MCP 服务器
/recap 命令在从聊天线程、例程或 webhook 转发时被拒绝，仅在终端、Claude 应用、远程控制、-p 或 SDK 主机中运行
工件发布拒绝网络共享路径（\\host\share 或 /net 自动挂载），除非通过 --add-dir 添加为映射网络驱动器
VS Code 的 CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR 设置现在仅当为绝对路径时生效，相对路径不再应用
applyFlagSettings({ ultracode: true }) 不再将努力级别切换为 xhigh，而是保持当前级别；如果 effortLevel 改变级别但未设置 ultracode，则关闭 Ultracode
非交互式首轮即使 CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_STARTUP_WAIT_MS 设为 0，仍会等待最多 2 秒以连接 allowedTools 或 mcp_tool 钩子指定的 MCP 服务器
GA 模型和 completions 方法上的 betas 参数已弃用，可能在未来版本中移除
移除了客户端侧压缩控制（client-side compaction control）
GA 模型和 completions 方法上的 betas 参数已弃用，可能在未来版本中移除
Shell 权限检查收紧，破坏性的 git、sed 和 tee 用法不再跳过权限确认，可能影响自动化流程
tee 不再被归类为只读命令，使用 tee 写入文件时需要权限确认
终端输入审批（terminal input approval）默认启用，针对以提升权限运行的命令，可能影响自动化脚本
从捆绑目录中移除了 GPT-5.4 模型，并保留迁移提示，使用该模型的用户需迁移
exec-server WebSocket 连接现在需要 bearer token 认证，包括通过 app-server 配置的连接，需更新连接配置

issue_insights.summary_brief: 本期跨仓库共性问题高度集中且围绕 Windows 平台展开：依赖加载失败（Playwright/greenlet、scipy._propack）、CLI 检测路径、5小时会话窗口硬性到期、桌面端更新重启失败，五个候选簇共波及 40+ 仓库、300+ 关联信号，是最高优先级的技术债。其中以 Windows 生态兼容性（原生库缺失、非 C 盘安装、MSIX/SIGILL 崩溃）与 Agent 框架会话/发布可靠性为两大核心主线。
global_highlights: 跨仓库五大共性簇中，Windows 平台依赖加载失败（Playwright/greenlet、scipy._propack 原生库缺失）为最响信号，波及 40+ 仓库、超 200 issue，Aider 生成 repo map 时直接崩溃即为典型。
Agent 框架的会话可靠性普遍堪忧：5 小时会话硬到期无暂停/继续（35 联动）、会话历史丢失/损坏在多仓库（Goose、OpenHands、claude-agent-sdk）反复出现,构成跨仓库第二大隐忧。
Windows 桌面端发布链路系统性受损：MSIX 安装失败(0x80073CF9)、更新后无法重启(0x80070020)、无 AVX2 CPU 上 SIGILL 崩溃(claude-code)、goose 更新卡死，表征为原生二进制与打包缺乏平台预检。
认证与权限控制面在自托管/云场景下普遍不完整：OpenHands API 密钥绕过、Anthropic SDK 的 can_use_tool 字段丢失、'always allow' 规则静默失效，安全与越权风险跨仓库蔓延。

top_pain_points.topic: Windows 上 Playwright/greenlet 依赖缺失导致 URL 抓取(web 命令)崩溃
top_pain_points.summary: 用户输入 URL 触发的自动 web 抓取在导入 playwright 时因 greenlet DLL 加载失败抛 ImportError(DLL load failed),命令无法执行。
aliases: OpenAI 兼容 provider 空响应
agent bash 调用被超时杀死
单 system 消息无 user 轮
子代理 token 用量丢失
服务部署请求全部失败
top_pain_points.review_reason: 窗口内贴 URL 是常用输入方式,依赖缺失使其直接从可用变为崩溃报错,属关键功能在特定环境下不可用。

source_issues.title: Uncaught ImportError in __init__.py line 29
source_issues.evidence: Windows(venv=False)上 check_for_urls -> cmd_web -> scrape_with_playwright 时 import greenlet 报 DLL load failed,web 抓取功能不可用且未捕获崩溃。

source_issues.title: bug: Worktree dependency_locations empty for monorepo root — causes ~1GB node_modules duplication per worktree
source_issues.evidence: 每个 worktree 都自带完整 node_modules（约 1GB+）而非通过 symlink 共享；project_index.json 的 dependency_locations 对根依赖为空，agent 在 worktree 内跑 npm install 生成全量副本，多 worktree 时每 worktree 额外浪费约 1GB 磁盘

source_issues.title: [BUG]: LLMEvaluator input_schema incompatible with create_dataset generated datasets
source_issues.evidence: 用官方 SDK create_dataset 生成的数据集返回嵌套 dict，喂给官方 HallucinationEvaluator 即抛 pydantic ValidationError，官方示例无法端到端跑通

source_issues.title: create_evaluator's tuple-to-Score conversion classifies strings by word count, not position, silently corrupting label/explanation
source_issues.evidence: _convert_to_score 元组分支按词数<=3 归为 label，相同词数时后写覆盖前写，官方文档示例 length_check 都被静默搞错 label="Length: 42" .../explanation 丢失，无报错无警告，造成静默数据丢失

source_issues.title: Evaluator runs fail on mappings for variables removed from the template
source_issues.evidence: 从模板删除变量后其 mapping 仍被保存，运行评估时对不存在的字段做路径匹配导致 path-did-not-match 失败，UI 没有行可修复，用户只能重输变量-清 mapping-再删除

source_issues.title: [BUG] gen_ai ingest: per-key setdefault merge corrupts llm.*_messages on dual-emitted spans (system prompt as user role, duplicated user message)
source_issues.evidence: decode_otlp_span 对 flattened key 逐 key setdefault 合并双源索引不同的消息，存储后 UI 上系统提示变成 user 消息且用户消息出现两次，数据被静默损坏

source_issues.title: [BUG]: executeSql on PostgreSQL: attributes ->> '$.llm.model_name' silently returns NULL / matches no rows while SQLite returns the value
source_issues.evidence: PostgreSQL 上 attributes ->> '$.llm.model_name' 静默返回 NULL、WHERE 匹配 0 行，而 SQLite 返回正确值，且自带错误提示正是推荐该拼写，用户拿到的 SQL 查询答案是错的且无任何报错

source_issues.title: [BUG]: Transient error StatusCode.RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED
source_issues.evidence: 把大 trace 数据导出到 Phoenix 时持续报 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED 并 32s 重试，用户无法确认数据是否成功入库，可能造成观测数据缺失

source_issues.title: [BUG]: Playground can't run OpenAI GPT-6 Sol/Luna/Astra on AWS Bedrock: default temperature=1 is always sent and rejected with 400
source_issues.evidence: 新版 AWS Playground 默认 config 恒发送 temperature:1，slider 无法清空，凡 Converse 不支持 temperature 的模型（GPT-6 全家）每次运行都 400，去掉该字段就成功

source_issues.title: [BUG]: Playground AWS Bedrock fails with ParamValidationError when a prompt replays a tool call (all models)
source_issues.evidence: AI 消息含 tool call 时 BedrockClient 直接 extend 原始 dict 而非转 ContentBlock，所有模型在请求到达前 ParamValidationError，工具回合完全无法运行

top_pain_points.topic: Windows 上 Claude CLI 安装路径不在 C 盘时无法被检测到

aliases: Agent 工具 schema 错误

source_issues.title: Bug: Custom OpenAI-compatible providers (Lemonade): 256k context window ignored

source_issues.title: Stream decode error: Failed to parse Responses stream event: missing field created_at
source_issues.evidence: 自定义 OpenAI-compatible provider（gpt-6-astra）缺 created_at 字段导致流解码严格失败，响应无法渲染、会话直接终止。

source_issues.title: OpenAI-compatible provider: tool image messages interrupt parallel tool results and cause HTTP 400
source_issues.evidence: 同一响应中两次 read_image 返回图像时，格式化器在两条 tool 结果间插入 user 图像消息，触发 HTTP 400 'insufficient tool messages'，真实模型端到端复现。

source_issues.title: [BUG] run_sql_query(limit=0) returns every row, because the guard is truthiness
source_issues.evidence: limit=0 returns all 20,000 rows (1.7 MB of JSON) to the model because 'if limit:' treats zero as unlimited; only None should mean all.

source_issues.title: [Bug] CsvTools ignores an explicit zero row limit
source_issues.evidence: row_limit=0 returns every CSV data row because 'row_limit or self.row_limit' treats zero as an omitted argument.

source_issues.title: [Bug] ShellTools and Workspace run_command return the whole output for tail=0 instead of none
source_issues.evidence: [-tail:] with tail=0 becomes [-0:] == [0:], returning the whole command output instead of an empty string.

source_issues.title: [Bug] PerplexitySearch and PubmedTools silently replace an explicit max_results=0 with the default
source_issues.evidence: 'max_results or self.max_results' replaces an explicit 0 with the toolkit default, ignoring the caller's explicit value.

source_issues.title: [Bug] FieldLabeledCSVReader silently drops paginated CSV for page_size=0
source_issues.evidence: page_size=0 causes range(0, total, 0) ValueError caught into returning [], so a valid CSV appears to contain no documents.

source_issues.title: [Bug] GithubTools.get_pull_request_count fails when branch filters are omitted
source_issues.evidence: Default call passes base=None/head=None to PyGithub get_pulls which asserts on None, raising AssertionError: None for the default and single-filter calls.

signals.review_reason: 长时间运行任务被强制中断且无保存继续能力，导致进度与上下文丢失，直接影响生产环境中的长任务可用性。

source_issues.title: No pause/continue option when 5-hour Claude Code session window expires
source_issues.evidence: Kanban 任务在 5 小时会话窗口到期时无暂停/继续/无缝切换选项，会话无警告到期导致用户丢失进度和上下文，影响长时间任务

signals.topic: 评估器创建/运行被阻断或静默产生错误评估结果
signals.summary: 用户使用官方 LLMEvaluator 配合官方 create_dataset 生成的嵌套 dict 数据集时直接触发 Pydantic 校验崩溃；create_evaluator 的元组转 Score 逻辑按词数而非位置分类字符串，静默把 label 和 explanation 搞混/覆盖；从模板移除变量后残留 mapping 导致评估运行失败且 UI 无法修复。三项都让评估主流程不稳定或产出错误结果。
signals.review_reason: 评估是 Phoenix 的核心主流程。用户按官方示例用官方数据集+sdk 创建/运行评估时要么直接崩溃、要么在完全无报错的情况下产出被搞混/覆盖的 label/explanation（静默数据损坏），要么因残留 mapping 无端失败。这些都是关键功能不可用或结果不可信，直接阻断评估工作流并可能把错误结果当正确结果使用。

source_issues.title: [BUG]: LLMEvaluator input_schema incompatible with create_dataset generated datasets
source_issues.evidence: 用官方 SDK create_dataset 生成的数据集返回嵌套 dict，喂给官方 HallucinationEvaluator 即抛 pydantic ValidationError，官方示例无法端到端跑通

source_issues.title: create_evaluator's tuple-to-Score conversion classifies strings by word count, not position, silently corrupting label/explanation
source_issues.evidence: _convert_to_score 元组分支按词数<=3 归为 label，相同词数时后写覆盖前写，官方文档示例 length_check 都被静默搞错 label="Length: 42" .../explanation 丢失，无报错无警告，造成静默数据丢失

source_issues.title: Evaluator runs fail on mappings for variables removed from the template
source_issues.evidence: 从模板删除变量后其 mapping 仍被保存，运行评估时对不存在的字段做路径匹配导致 path-did-not-match 失败，UI 没有行可修复，用户只能重输变量-清 mapping-再删除

signals.topic: 观测数据在摄取合并或查询时被静默损坏/缺失，导致 trace/span 数据不可信
signals.summary: OTel gen_ai 与 OpenInference 双发 span 时 per-key setdefault 合并会把 system prompt 记成 user 并重复 user 消息；executeSql 在 PostgreSQL 上对嵌套 JSON 路径返回静默 NULL/0 行而 SQLite 正常；trace 导出遇大流量报 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED 重试并可能丢数据。用户在观测数据这一核心功能上拿到缺失或错误的 span。
signals.review_reason: 观测/可观测框架是 Phoenix 的产品根基。span 摄取合并会把消息顺序静默改坏（系统条变成 user、用户条重复），executeSql 对使用其推荐拼写的查询在 PostgreSQL 返回错误的 NULL/0 行，trace 导出在数据量大时反复 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED。这些都让用户拿到的核心观测数据缺失、错误或不可信，直接削弱关键功能的价值。

source_issues.title: [BUG] gen_ai ingest: per-key setdefault merge corrupts llm.*_messages on dual-emitted spans (system prompt as user role, duplicated user message)
source_issues.evidence: decode_otlp_span 对 flattened key 逐 key setdefault 合并双源索引不同的消息，存储后 UI 上系统提示变成 user 消息且用户消息出现两次，数据被静默损坏

source_issues.title: [BUG]: executeSql on PostgreSQL: attributes ->> '$.llm.model_name' silently returns NULL / matches no rows while SQLite returns the value
source_issues.evidence: PostgreSQL 上 attributes ->> '$.llm.model_name' 静默返回 NULL、WHERE 匹配 0 行，而 SQLite 返回正确值，且自带错误提示正是推荐该拼写，用户拿到的 SQL 查询答案是错的且无任何报错

source_issues.title: [BUG]: Transient error StatusCode.RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED
source_issues.evidence: 把大 trace 数据导出到 Phoenix 时持续报 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED 并 32s 重试，用户无法确认数据是否成功入库，可能造成观测数据缺失

signals.topic: Playground 对部分模型/请求无法运行（Bedrock 温度参数、tools 回放、高推理超时）
signals.summary: Playground 在 AWS Bedrock 上对 GPT-6 系等模型因默认恒定发送 temperature:1 被 400 拒；回放含 tool call 的 prompt 时所有模型触发 ParamValidationError 无法发起请求；高 reasoning effort 模型因 90s 硬编码超时被判定 'Playground task timed out'。用户在 Playground 这一核心交互页反复无法执行。
signals.review_reason: Playground 是用户日常试模型/调 prompt 的核心功能。默认配置就发送被模型拒绝的温度参数、所有模型在重放工具调用时都在请求发出前崩溃、高推理模型因硬编码超时被误判失败。三个独立场景全部阻断 Playground 的正常使用，主流程不可用且无配置化规避手段，用户体验显著受损。

source_issues.title: [BUG]: Playground can't run OpenAI GPT-6 Sol/Luna/Astra on AWS Bedrock: default temperature=1 is always sent and rejected with 400
source_issues.evidence: 新版 AWS Playground 默认 config 恒发送 temperature:1，slider 无法清空，凡 Converse 不支持 temperature 的模型（GPT-6 全家）每次运行都 400，去掉该字段就成功

source_issues.title: [BUG]: Playground AWS Bedrock fails with ParamValidationError when a prompt replays a tool call (all models)
source_issues.evidence: AI 消息含 tool call 时 BedrockClient 直接 extend 原始 dict 而非转 ContentBlock，所有模型在请求到达前 ParamValidationError，工具回合完全无法运行

source_issues.title: [BUG]: Playground fails with "Playground task timed out" on high reasoning effort models
source_issues.evidence: stream 拉取 watchdog 硬编码 90s，高推理模型思考超过即被判超时，无任何可配置项，只能改源码；fork 后提到 900s 即可正常完成

signals.topic: 数据集更新/同名单上传被 409 阻断，且含错误 run 的实验无法导出
signals.summary: 对已存在数据集第二次 upload_dataset 直接抛 DatasetUploadError/409，用户被强制自行处理版本并为每次变更新建数据集，无法跨版本比较实验结果；含任一 errored run 的实验导出 JSON/CSV 时整份下载 500 失败（run.output 缺 task_output 触发未处理的 KeyError），单个失败示例阻断整个导出。
signals.review_reason: 数据集是评估实验的载体，导出是用户取回结果的关键动作。上传同名单被 409 阻断使版本管理/跨版本对比这一承诺功能不可用，而实验只要有一个错误示例就整份无法导出并可能被 CLI 静默丢弃。两处都让数据管理和结果交付的主流程被直接阻断，且错误提示(静默跳过)会误导用户。

source_issues.title: [docs][datasets]: enhance dataset documentation
source_issues.evidence: 文档声称数据集版本化，但二次上传同名牌组抛 409/DatasetUploadError，用户被迫每次新建数据集，无法跨版本对比评估结果；非仅文档问题，是版本管理主流程被阻断

source_issues.title: Experiment JSON/CSV export 500s when an experiment contains an errored run
source_issues.evidence: 包含任一 errored run 时导出端点对 run.output['task_output'] 抛 KeyError 变 500，整个实验无法导出，且 px experiment list 批量下载静默跳过失败项却报成功

signals.topic: 成本/计费静默按旧模型费率计费，且缺失价格在 UI 不可见
signals.summary: 内置成本模型的 name_pattern 用未锚定的子串匹配，新发布且 ID 是旧模型前缀（claude-opus-5-5→claude-opus-5）的模型在清单跟上之前在旧费率下静默计费，span 成本在摄取时算一次且不复算，历史 span 持久错误；缺价显示为零成本，使错误计费完全不可见。
signals.review_reason: 计费金额是用户直接的经济成本。新模型在清单更新前被按旧模型费率静默计费，成本在摄取时固化导致历史数据错误且 UI 完全看不出（缺价显示零成本掩盖错误），用户会在毫无提示的情况下看到错误的成本数字，属于明显成本/数据损失，虽单条但影响明确。

source_issues.title: Cost tracking silently bills new models at an older prefix model's rates (claude-opus-5-5 → claude-opus-5)
source_issues.evidence: name_pattern 为未锚定 substring，新的 claude-opus-5-5 被当作 claude-opus-5 计费高 25%，span 成本摄取时算一次不复算且无任何日志/标记，现有部署至今仍带错误 Opus5.5 计费，缺失价格在 UI 显示为零而错误价格那样静默

signals.topic: 对话数据损坏会导致会话历史无法恢复甚至整个会话列表不可用
signals.summary: 对话数据损坏后用户无法加载会话,部分情况下单条损坏的会话会使整个历史列表崩溃,用户被迫删除全部本地数据才能恢复,历史工作内容丢失且无法定位到具体损坏文件。
signals.review_reason: 会话历史不可恢复与整个列表崩溃直接导致用户历史工作内容丢失并被迫删光本地数据,是明确的数据损失痛点,影响显著但非核心流程常发,故为 P1。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Conversation corrupted after VM restart: "Missing event file"
source_issues.evidence: VM 重启后加载会话返回 500 'Missing event file',用户称 'Seems impossible to recover :(',会话数据corrupted后似乎无法恢复。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Corrupted conversation data breaks the entire conversation history list instead of handling individual broken conversations
source_issues.evidence: 单条会话数据损坏导致整个会话历史列表加载失败;由于 ID 是无意义 UUID 无法定位损坏文件,用户被迫删除所有本地会话数据才能恢复。

signals.topic: 自托管/云上 LLM 连接失败导致会话首条消息无法进行
signals.summary: 部分 LLM 提供商(如 AWS Bedrock)因缺少依赖模块无法建立连接,部分 openhands/claude-* 模型因版本解析出新的 litellm 而在首次 LLM 调用即返回 400,导致会话无法正常开始或推进。
signals.review_reason: 模型连接失败使用户发送首条消息后无响应或收到 400 错误,会话完全无法进行,属于关键功能不可用,但影响受具体提供商/解析时机触发而非全部用户,故 P1。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: litellm.APIConnectionError: No module named 'boto3'
source_issues.evidence: 使用 AWS Bedrock 的用户在 Web UI 输入 prompt 后无任何回复,日志显示因缺少 boto3 模块导致 litellm 无法认证,模型调用完全失败。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Canvas conversations on openhands/claude-* fail with 400 on prompt_cache_key (uvx resolves litellm>=1.99)

signals.topic: 自托管部署的 API 认证失效/密钥暴露导致越权访问风险
signals.summary: 自托管场景下会话密钥未被正确导出导致 agent-server 所有 API 认证绕过,以及前端监听所有网络接口并把会话密钥注入页面导致同网段可窃取凭证,存在严重的安全与越权风险。
signals.review_reason: 认证绕过意味着任何能触达 /api 的人都能执行操作,会话密钥注入前端可被同网段窃取,均直接造成越权访问与敏感信息泄露,是明确且严重的用户影响,故保留并标 P1。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Self-hosted LOCAL_BACKEND_API_KEY is not exported to OH_SESSION_API_KEYS_0 in entrypoint.sh, causing agent-server auth bypass
source_issues.evidence: entrypoint.sh 只在未提供 key 的分支导出会话密钥,用户显式设置 LOCAL_BACKEND_API_KEY 时被跳过,导致 agent-server 以空 session_api_keys 启动、认证检查无条件通过,所有 /api 路由可被无认证访问。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Local stack exposes the session API key to LAN peers

signals.topic: 自托管自动化功能在升级后运行失败或在无自动化配置时持续报错
signals.summary: 自托管 Canvas 升级后 prompt 预设模板与所固定的 agent-server 版本不匹配导致每次运行都 500;另有自动化轮询器不带会话密钥导致每分钟弹一次 401 toast,干扰告警获得真实通知。
signals.review_reason: 自动化每次运行 500 使自托管核心自动化能力完全不可用,401 轮询噪音干扰真实告警接收,均有具体复现与影响证据,故保留。(说明:两条 issue 的确切来源匹配中 I 对 #17706 与 #16879 的证据摘录出现编号填写笔误,但不影响其主体证据已从正文核对。)

source_issues.title: Prompt-preset automations created on agent-canvas 1.17.0 fail every run with 500 on /api/conversations/{id}/events
source_issues.evidence: 升级到 1.17.0 后,所有通过 prompt 预设新建的自动化每次运行都以 500 失败(探测 3/3、真实自动化 4/4 失败),回滚预设模板后成功;根因是预设模板的 finish-tool 接线与所固定的 agent-server 1.46.0 不匹配。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Automations poller calls GET /api/automation/v1 without X-Session-API-Key, raising a 401 toast every minute on self-hosted
source_issues.evidence: 自托管无自动化时 UI 每分钟无密钥轮询一次 /api/automation/v1 得到 401 并弹出 toast(三小时 86 次),会训练用户无视真实告警。

signals.topic: Windows 本地后端下核心工作区/规划器功能不可用
signals.summary: Windows 宿主机配合本地后端时,Planner 标签页因 POSIX 路径校验误判而失败,文件标签页始终显示无文件,导致 Windows 用户的核心工作区与规划功能不可用。
signals.review_reason: Windows 平台用户的核心规划与文件浏览功能不可用是明确功能故障,但问题受限于单一平台且用例数较少,故 P2 保留。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Planner tab fails with "Conversation file path must stay inside the workspace" on Windows local backend
source_issues.evidence: Windows 本地后端打开任一对话的 Planner 标签页都失败,因其路径校验 normalizeAbsolutePath 只接受 POSIX 路径,对 Windows 盘符路径总返回 null,在发请求前即抛异常。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Files tab always shows "No files in workspace" on Windows local backend
source_issues.evidence: Windows 本地后端文件标签页始终显示 'No files in workspace',文件列表功能失效。

signals.topic: find_capability 无法检索到已存储的 skill，导致 copilot 走错执行路径并失败重试
signals.summary: AutoGPT copilot 的 find_capability 只搜索 tool/block/mcp_server 类型，不含已存储的 skill。系统提示要求任何集成请求必须先走 find_capability，导致一个为特定任务量身编写的 skill 不会出现在结果中，agent 转而采用不合适的 MCP/block 路径，执行失败后重试，降低任务可靠性与用户体验。
signals.review_reason: 这是用户在真实使用中会反复遇到的代理功能失效问题：copilot 内置检索功能遗漏了最合适的已存储 skill，迫使 agent 走低效的 MCP/block 路径后失败再重试。证据来自线上（production turn）copilot 追踪快照，明确记录了任务执行失败与重试。虽然不阻断整个流程，但直接导致任务执行错误、可靠性和效率明显下降，属于影响明显的非阻断型痛点。

source_issues.title: find_capability doesn't search skills
source_issues.evidence: 在 production turn 中，一个创建 Linear 工单的团队 skill 完全匹配请求，但 find_capability 只返回 blocks 和 Linear MCP server，copilot 单独加载 skill 后走 MCP 路径、失败一次再重试。评审结论：'the skill should have been surfaced in find_capability, it's literally perfect'。系统提示将 find_capability 设为任何集成请求的强制第一步。

signals.topic: 桌面端会话历史可靠性：长期/带参数的会话与已保存内容无法加载或直接丢失
signals.summary: Goose Desktop 会话历史不可靠，用户已保存的会话/配方在升级、重启或长时间使用后会打不开或直接消失，属主流程阻断。
signals.review_reason: 这是用户核心工作流（桌面端查看/恢复历史会话）的阻断与数据丢失问题：长期会话永久打不开、升级后历史记录消失、常用配方无法再加载，均直接导致用户不可访问自己已保存的工作上下文。不同根因但用户可感知的痛点一致：桌面端会话历史不可信。虽然存在数据丢失的严重性，但根因各不相同且难以百分百复现，故定级 P1。

source_issues.title: Possible v1.52.0 regression: Goose Desktop loses chat history after restart
source_issues.evidence: 升级 v1.51.0→v1.52.0 并重启后，一条长生命周期对话从 Session History 彻底消失，数据库/WAL/备份中都找不到其记录；用户丢失重要里程碑工作数据。

source_issues.title: Long sessions become permanently unopenable in the desktop: session/load replay outruns the ACP transport and the connection is dropped
source_issues.evidence: 足够长的会话在桌面打开时稳定复现 'Failed to Load Session — ACP connection closed'，每个会话每次重开都失败，而 CLI 可正常加载。

source_issues.title: Recipe snapshots stored in session history fail Goose's own template validation, blocking recipes from loading in Desktop
source_issues.evidence: 运行过带参数的配方后，其在桌面中变得无法加载（开始7、7、5个最常用配方全部失败），而磁盘上的配方文件仍有效。

signals.topic: 自定义 OpenAI 兼容提供方在上下文窗口、流解码、工具图像等场景下功能失效
signals.summary: 使用自建/自定义 OpenAI 兼容 provider（llama.cpp、DeepSeek、Lemonade 等）时，Goose 在保留上下文窗口、解析 SSE 流、批量工具图像等环节出错，导致请求被拒或功能降级。
signals.review_reason: 自定义 OpenAI 兼容 provider 是自托管用户的核心使用方式，三起 bug 分别造成上下文容量被错误压缩、流式响应直接失败、批量工具多模态交互 400，均阻断或显著劣化主流程，且都有可复现的真实请求证据。因根因各异且局限于自定义 provider 场景，未满 P0 所需的主流程普适阻断，定级 P1。

source_issues.title: Bug: Custom OpenAI-compatible providers (Lemonade): 256k context window ignored
source_issues.evidence: 服务端声明 256k 上下文但 discovery 不读取，回退到 128k 默认值导致过早上下文压缩；桌面表单还无法设置/保存 per-model context_limit，手工改写被 UI 覆盖。

source_issues.title: Stream decode error: Failed to parse Responses stream event: missing field created_at
source_issues.evidence: 自定义 OpenAI-compatible provider（gpt-6-astra）缺 created_at 字段导致流解码严格失败，响应无法渲染、会话直接终止。

source_issues.title: OpenAI-compatible provider: tool image messages interrupt parallel tool results and cause HTTP 400
source_issues.evidence: 同一响应中两次 read_image 返回图像时，格式化器在两条 tool 结果间插入 user 图像消息，触发 HTTP 400 'insufficient tool messages'，真实模型端到端复现。

signals.topic: Windows 桌面端更新/安装重启流程失败，更新无法生效或界面卡死
signals.summary: Goose Desktop 在 Windows 上的内置更新在下载后安装失败、或点击'安装并重启'无反应/界面无响应，导致用户无法完成升级。
signals.review_reason: 多个 Windows 用户更新 Goose Desktop 时遭遇安装后无法重启生效、更新按钮无响应、UI 冻结，升级这一基础操作反复失败，用户被卡在旧版本或界面卡死，影响可感知。

source_issues.title: Windows: In-app update to v1.52.0 fails after download, manual download does not replace v1.50
source_issues.evidence: 内置更新下载后安装失败，手动下载也无法替换旧版本，停留在 v1.50。

source_issues.title: 更新下载后，点击 安装并重启 没反应
source_issues.evidence: 下载更新后点击安装并重启无任何反应，升级流程无法完成。

source_issues.title: UI freezes and "Install & Restart" button is unresponsive when updating goose Desktop app on Windows 11
source_issues.evidence: Windows 11 更新时 UI 冻结、安装并重启按钮无响应。

signals.topic: 推理模型仅在 thinking 块内产出 / 输出被 thinking 消耗殆尽时，agent 静默结束回合无任何答复
signals.summary: 推理型模型返回仅含 reasoning 的响应或全部 token 被 reasoning_content 耗尽时，Goose 静默退出回合，用户等不到答复也收不到错误提示。
signals.review_reason: 用户明确遭遇'任务进行到一半 agent 停止且无任何输出或错误'，最高等待 19 分钟毫无反馈，主流程静默失败、体验显著下降且难以诊断。属反复出现的静默阻塞，影响面覆盖所有本地推理模型用户。

source_issues.title: A response containing only a thinking block silently ends the turn
source_issues.evidence: 真实部署中网关提前终止流产生 2 次 thinking-only 回合，用户分别空等 19.3 和 15.3 分钟才手动推动，agent 无输出、无日志、无重试。

source_issues.title: Reasoning models produce empty content: max_tokens shared between reasoning_content and content
source_issues.evidence: reasoning:true 时未上调 max_tokens，verbose thinking 消耗全部配额导致 content=0，用户看到空响应、finish_reason=length，无任何错误/警告。影响 DeepSeek、Nemotron、Qwen3-thinking 等所有本地推理模型。

signals.topic: macOS 14 桌面端 dictation Metal 探测 panic 导致前端界面卡死
signals.summary: macOS 14 上探测 Metal 设备时底层类查找 panic，拖垮进行中的异步任务，导致 Session History 与模型切换器等前端功能挂起直到重启应用。
signals.review_reason: 用户在 macOS 14 上打开设置即触发 panic，前端多个区域（历史、模型切换）卡死直到重启，体验显著下降；虽为单仓单线程且平台受限、非主流程普遍阻断，但后果直观（界面挂起），予以保留并定级 P2。

source_issues.title: Dictation Metal-probe panics on macOS 14 ("class MTLResidencySetDescriptor could not be found")
source_issues.evidence: macOS 14 打开设置(聊天页)即触发 Metal 探测 panic，拖垮 in-flight 请求，Session History 卡在 loading、模型切换器直到重启才恢复响应。

signals.topic: 多模型 formatter 在多模态/远程媒体数据的下载与传递上静默丢数据或阻塞事件循环
signals.summary: 多个模型 formatter 存在数据丢失与性能问题：#2895 在 async formatter 里用同步 requests.get 下载远程音频/PDF/图片，阻塞整个事件循环并拖慢同进程所有协程与 WebSocket；#2907 OpenAI Responses 适配器丢弃 response.reasoning_text.delta 事件，推理文本为空；#2780 DeepSeek flash 丢弃支持传入的图片 DataBlock；#2906 MCPTool 丢弃 structured-only 的工具返回结果，外部拿到空成功；#2859 GoalPipeline 重试指令把 base64 载荷作为 repr 泄入 prompt。
signals.review_reason: 多模态/远程媒体在多个官方模型适配器上被静默丢弃或阻塞事件循环，用户传入的图片/音频/PDF 无法到达模型或导致整个异步流程卡顿，直接造成关键功能不可用与并发体验下降。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: sync requests.get blocks the async event loop in OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini/Ollama formatters
source_issues.evidence: async def format 中调用同步 requests.get(timeout=30)，repro 显示下载期间 ticker 完全暂停约 30s，事件循环被阻塞。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: OpenAI Responses adapter drops response.reasoning_text.delta events
source_issues.evidence: 在阿里云 Bailian deepseek-v4.1-flash 开启 thinking 时，endpoint 返回的 reasoning_text.delta 被丢弃，ThinkingBlock.thinking 为空字符串。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: DeepSeek formatters discard supported image DataBlocks for deepseek-flash
source_issues.evidence: 即使 input_types 含 image/png，DeepSeekChatFormatter/MultiAgentFormatter 仍丢弃图片，多图消息退化为纯文本或空，模型卡声明的图片能力实际不可用。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: XAIMultiAgentFormatter drops all media despite declaring image support
source_issues.evidence: xAI 多智能体 formatter 声明支持图片却丢弃全部媒体。

signals.topic: 流式 LLM 工具调用无参数时输入为空导致所有无参工具调用失败
signals.summary: AnthropicChatModel（及共用解析器的 MiniMaxChatModel）在流式响应中解析无参数工具调用时，将输入保留为空字符串 ""，随后 agent 按 JSON 解析失败抛 ToolJSONDecodeError，导致工具不执行。这会影响所有无参工具，包括每个会话都会内置的 TaskList、CompressContext 及无参 MCP 工具，直接破坏主流程（流式是默认方式）。
signals.review_reason: 流式是默认方式，所有不带参数的内部与 MCP 工具（含每个会话都内置的 TaskList）都会失效，工具调用主流程被阻断，属于反复出现的功能不可用。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: A streamed Anthropic tool call with no arguments gets an empty input and always fails
source_issues.evidence: tool_call_stream 无 input_json_delta 时输入保持 ''，agent 以 _agent.py:2489 读 '' 为 JSON 抛 ToolJSONDecodeError，TaskList 从未执行，结果 state=error；stream=False 时输入为 '{}' 可正常运行。

signals.topic: Tool parameter limit=0 is treated as omitted, so queries run against the full dataset and return all rows
signals.summary: A recurring falsy-zero bug across toolkits: an explicit limit/row_limit/tail/max_results of 0 is treated as 'not provided' and replaced by the default or the unlimited path, returning the whole table/output instead of zero rows. This can push megabyte-sized results and full-table data into the model context.
signals.review_reason: A cross-cutting correctness defect: explicit zero limits are silently ignored across SQL/CSV/shell/search tools, causing whole-dataset reads, oversized context, and unexpected full output or empty results.

source_issues.title: [BUG] run_sql_query(limit=0) returns every row, because the guard is truthiness
source_issues.evidence: limit=0 returns all 20,000 rows (1.7 MB of JSON) to the model because 'if limit:' treats zero as unlimited; only None should mean all.

source_issues.title: [Bug] CsvTools ignores an explicit zero row limit
source_issues.evidence: row_limit=0 returns every CSV data row because 'row_limit or self.row_limit' treats zero as an omitted argument.

source_issues.title: [Bug] ShellTools and Workspace run_command return the whole output for tail=0 instead of none
source_issues.evidence: [-tail:] with tail=0 becomes [-0:] == [0:], returning the whole command output instead of an empty string.

source_issues.title: [Bug] PerplexitySearch and PubmedTools silently replace an explicit max_results=0 with the default
source_issues.evidence: 'max_results or self.max_results' replaces an explicit 0 with the toolkit default, ignoring the caller's explicit value.

source_issues.title: [Bug] FieldLabeledCSVReader silently drops paginated CSV for page_size=0
source_issues.evidence: page_size=0 causes range(0, total, 0) ValueError caught into returning [], so a valid CSV appears to contain no documents.

signals.topic: GithubTools helper functions fail or misbehave (branch filters, pagination, non-ASCII content, Enterprise URLs)
signals.summary: Multiple GithubTools helpers return broken results: get_pull_request_count asserts when branch filters are omitted, search pagination ignores custom per_page and skips matches, get_file_content misclassifies valid non-ASCII UTF-8 text as binary, and create_branch returns the API URL instead of a web URL on GitHub Enterprise.
signals.review_reason: Several common GitHub agent actions (count PRs, search, read files, create branches) break or return misleading output, making GitHub-automation agents fail or act on wrong data.

source_issues.title: [Bug] GithubTools.get_pull_request_count fails when branch filters are omitted
source_issues.evidence: Default call passes base=None/head=None to PyGithub get_pulls which asserts on None, raising AssertionError: None for the default and single-filter calls.

source_issues.title: [Bug] GithubTools search pagination ignores custom per_page values
source_issues.evidence: search_repositories/issues_and_prs truncate locally but SDK requests retain default page size 30; per_page=100 returns only 30 and page=2 skips rows.

source_issues.title: [Bug] GithubTools.get_file_content treats valid non-ASCII UTF-8 text as binary
source_issues.evidence: A UTF-8 README whose first 1000 chars contain >200 non-ASCII chars (e.g. Chinese) is returned as 'Binary file (content not displayed)', so the agent cannot read the document.

source_issues.title: [Bug] GithubTools.create_branch returns an API URL on GitHub Enterprise
source_issues.evidence: Branch URL is built by replacing text in the API ref URL assuming api.github.com, so on Enterprise it keeps /api/v3/repos/ and is not the branch web page.

signals.topic: Knowledge ingestion silently loses text or crashes on valid inputs (chunking/readers)
signals.summary: Ingestion paths drop or fail on valid content: RecursiveChunking skips text after short headings when overlap is enabled (unindexable text loss), JSONReader crashes on temp-file streams with non-string names, ReaderFactory shares mutable readers so per-call settings are ignored, and WebsiteReader async_read can't use async-only chunking.
signals.review_reason: Knowledge base ingestion silently drops content or crashes on valid inputs, meaning users' data is not fully indexed/retrievable or ingestion fails outright.

source_issues.title: [Bug] RecursiveChunking skips text after short headings when overlap is enabled
source_issues.evidence: With chunk_size=1000/overlap=100 and a short heading followed by a body, a range of text between chunks is absent from every chunk, so it cannot be indexed for retrieval (silent text loss).

source_issues.title: [Bug] JSONReader crashes on temporary file streams with non-string names
source_issues.evidence: On macOS tempfile.TemporaryFile.name is an int and SpooledTemporaryFile.name is None; JSONReader calls name.split() and raises AttributeError, so readable temporary uploads can't be ingested.

source_issues.title: [Bug] ReaderFactory shares mutable readers and ignores per-call options
source_issues.evidence: create_reader caches a per-type instance, so later chunk_size/allowed_hosts options are ignored and two Knowledge objects share one mutable reader; settings leak across users/sites and change unexpectedly.

source_issues.title: [Bug] WebsiteReader.async_read() calls synchronous chunking
source_issues.evidence: WebsiteReader.async_read() calls sync chunk(); any chunking strategy implementing only achunk() fails instead of returning documents, so async-only strategies can't be used with website ingestion.

signals.topic: Vector DB metadata filters silently return empty or wrong results (booleans never match, failed lookups treated as absent)
signals.summary: Several vector store backends mis-handle metadata filter queries so that legitimate documents are silently not returned: PgVector compiles boolean values as 'True'/'False' that can never match jsonb, ChromaDb treats a failed lookup as 'content absent' and duplicates chunks, and Cassandra never matches boolean criteria.
signals.review_reason: Retrieval/deletion across multiple vector backends silently returns empty or stale/wrong results under normal filter usage, degrading search correctness for users without any log signal that data is being missed.

source_issues.title: [Bug] PgVector metadata EQ/IN filters compile booleans as 'True'/'False' and silently match nothing
source_issues.evidence: EQ('urgent', True) compiles to (meta_data ->> 'urgent') = 'True' against stored jsonb true, so retrieval returns zero documents without any error.

source_issues.title: [Bug] ChromaDb.content_hash_exists reports a failed lookup as absent, so upsert skips the delete and duplicates chunks
source_issues.evidence: content_hash_exists returns False on any exception (connection/timeout/permission), so a failed lookup is treated as new content and the upsert duplicates chunks, mixing stale and current content in retrieval.

source_issues.title: [Bug] Cassandra.delete_by_metadata silently ignores boolean metadata criteria
source_issues.evidence: Write path stores {'archived': 'True'} while the matcher compares 'True' != True, so delete_by_metadata never matches a boolean criterion and leaves documents behind while reporting False.

signals.topic: Retryable and normal-flow agent/provider events are logged at ERROR, tripling error-tracker events per failure
signals.summary: Retryable API errors and events agno already handles as normal control flow (RetryAgentRun, model argument mistakes, tool not found) are logged at ERROR, and a single provider failure or tool failure can appear three times, flooding Sentry/log aggregators and hiding the real failures.
signals.review_reason: Degrades observability for every user routing logs to an error tracker: noise drowns real failures and recovery paths look like outages, hurting production monitoring. Demonstrated repeatedly across adapters and layers.

source_issues.title: [Bug] Claude, Gemini and OpenAI log retryable API errors at ERROR before base.py retries them (Claude: as "status 200")
source_issues.evidence: Author states this is the single noisiest line in their logs; every occurrence recovered on retry yet leaves an ERROR per attempt, e.g. 'Claude API error (status 200)' for a recovered overload.

source_issues.title: [Bug] One provider failure in an agent run is logged three times at ERROR
source_issues.evidence: Repro shows three ERROR records with the same message for one failure (adapter, retry loop, run handler); users sending ERROR logs to an error tracker get three events for one failure.

source_issues.title: [Bug] Tool layer logs RetryAgentRun and model mistakes at ERROR, and one tool failure three times
source_issues.evidence: A tool that raises RetryAgentRun (handled as control flow) logs ERROR; one ValueError inside a tool produces three records; fabricated tool names and bad JSON log ERROR. Users with logging-on-error integrations get spurious alerts.

signals.topic: 使用 GraalVM Native Image 构建 Spring Boot 应用时 SDK 运行时失败（500 错误），因缺少反射/序列化 reachability 元数据
signals.summary: SDK 缺少 GraalVM Native Image 的 reachability 元数据。用户在 Spring Boot 4.1.1 + Oracle GraalVM 25.0.4 环境用 native:compile 构建后运行，调用 /chat 接口返回 500 Internal Server Error，根因是 Kotlin 反射与序列化模型层次（如 MessageCreateParams$Body、JsonField$IsMissing、KnownValue）在编译期无法被静态分析解析，导致原生镜像运行失败。
signals.review_reason: 这是用户可感知的主流程故障：SDK 面向 Spring Boot 的原生镜像部署在成功完成构建后，运行时所有 /chat 调用直接以 500 报错，核心聊天功能完全不可用，且问题源于 SDK 自身缺少 reachability 元数据而非用户使用错误。由于 count=1 且仅单仓，按规则不标 P0，但该故障对原生镜像部署场景是硬阻断，故定为 P1。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Native Image runtime failure due to missing GraalVM reachability metadata
source_issues.evidence: 提供可复现的最小 Spring Boot 应用：JVM 下 curl /chat 返回 SUCCESS，但 native:compile 原生镜像下同请求返回 500 Internal Server Error。初始报错 kotlin.reflect.jvm.internal.KotlinReflectionInternalError 提示未解析类 com.anthropic.models.messages.MessageCreateParams$Body；手动注册该类后又出现 JsonField$IsMissing、KnownValue 缺失，说明 SDK 序列化模型层次存在更大范围缺失的 GraalVM reachability 元数据。

signals.topic: 流式返回中途发生传输错误时以原始 httpx 异常逃逸，绕过 APIError 异常层级并禁用重试
signals.summary: SDK 只在初始发送时把 httpx 传输错误包装为 APITimeoutError/APIConnectionError 并进入重试循环，但流式响应一旦开始读取，中途的超时或断连就直接以原始 httpx.ReadTimeout / httpx.RemoteProtocolError 抛出，既不属于 anthropic.APIError（excep 捕获不到最常见的流式失败），也不再参考 max_retries，导致设置了重试的客户端实际只发起一次请求。
signals.review_reason: 用户在使用 SDK 处理流式响应时遇到最常见的失败（读超时/断连）会被原始 httpx 异常逃脱，导致基于 anthropic.APIError 的错误处理捕获不到、配置的重试次数不生效——这是生产代码中反复出现的实际运行故障，直接影响错误处理正确性和容错能力。

source_issues.title: Transport errors while consuming a stream escape as raw httpx exceptions instead of `APITimeoutError` / `APIConnectionError`
source_issues.evidence: 离线复现显示曾设置 max_retries=2，但实际输出 'requests made with max_retries=2: 1' 且 'escaped: httpx.ReadTimeout'、'isinstance(e, anthropic.APIError) = False'；'except anthropic.APIError around a streaming call misses the most common streaming failure'。

signals.topic: 同时使用 thinking + structured output 时模型跳过工具调用并直接返回幻觉 JSON
signals.summary: 在 Vertex 上，Claude Sonnet 4.6 结合 adaptive thinking 与结构化输出（output_config.format=json_schema）并附带工具时，模型在第一轮就直接 stop_reason:end_turn 返回编造的 JSON，而不是先调用工具；禁用 thinking 后行为恢复正常。
aliases: 工具调用被幻觉 JSON 跳过
signals.review_reason: 当用户组合 thinking + structured output 驱动 agent 时，工具根本不会被调用，模型直接编造未经过工具返回的 JSON 数据，破坏 agent 型应用的完整性与约束流程，属于关键功能（tool use 工作流）在特定配置下的实际失效。

source_issues.title: Claude Sonnet 4.6 doesn't call tools properly when thinking + structured output is used
source_issues.evidence: 实际行为：'The model returns a JSON in turn 1 without calling any tools'，turn1 直接 end_turn 且包含 thinking 'Let me fetch both simultaneously'；期望行为在禁用 thinking 时可复现，且提供完整复现脚本。

signals.topic: Managed Agents 每次工具调用的外层超时被硬编码为 150 秒且无法配置，长耗时命令被强制终止
signals.summary: EnvironmentWorker/SessionToolRunner 对每个工具调用使用硬编码 TOOL_TIMEOUT=150s 的外层 anyio.fail_after，没有构造参数或环境变量可修改，导致自托管 agent 通过 bash 工具运行 make check、完整 pytest 等超过 150 秒的命令时被外层超时杀死，自定义 bash 工具自身的 timeout_ms 处理也永远不会执行。
aliases: agent bash 调用被超时杀死
signals.review_reason: 自托管环境 worker 中 agent 通过 bash 运行实际仓库的构建与测试时，合法的长耗时调用（如 make check、完整 pytest 运行）会被固定 150 秒外层超时强杀，且 SDK 未提供任何配置手段，用户只能拆分任务、后台轮询或 monkeypatch 私有常量，属于对运行流程的实际阻断与可用性损失。

source_issues.title: Managed Agents: make SessionToolRunner's per-tool-call TOOL_TIMEOUT (150 s) configurable on EnvironmentWorker
source_issues.evidence: 'this makes the bash tool's own timeout_ms argument effectively capped at ~150 s regardless of what the caller passes'；'Self-hosted workers running real repositories routinely need a single bash call (make check, a full pytest run) to exceed 150 s. Today the only options are to split the work ... or to monkeypatch the private constant.'

signals.topic: 使用 @anthropic-ai/aws-sdk 的 Client（AWS SigV4 认证）时，EnvironmentWorker 无法创建，需绕道设置假的 authToken
signals.summary: 在 copyClientForHelper 中检测 authToken 是否设置来创建 EnvironmentWorker，而使用 @anthropic-ai/aws-sdk 的 Client 在 AWS 平台上通过 SigV4 签名认证时不会设置 authToken，导致 EnvironmentWorker 创建直接失败。用户必须传入 "dummy" 之类的假 authToken 才能绕过错误正常工作。
signals.review_reason: 用户在 Claude Platform on AWS 上使用官方 AWS SDK Client 时，创建 EnvironmentWorker 这一主流程直接失败，需要手写假 authToken 作为 workaround 才能继续。这是真实用户可见的阻断性缺陷，来自对特定官方支持集成（AWS）的破坏，而非功能请求。

source_issues.title: `EnvironmentWorker` cannot be created with the `Client` class from `@anthropic-ai/aws-sdk`
source_issues.evidence: Creating an EnvironmentWorker fails when authToken is not specified. When using Claude Platform on AWS with the Client class from @anthropic-ai/aws-sdk, authentication is handled via AWS SigV4 signing so authToken is not set, which prevents EnvironmentWorker from being created. Specifying a value such as "dummy" for authToken avoids the error and allows EnvironmentWorker to operate normally.

signals.topic: jsonSchemaOutputFormat 会静默丢弃可空(array-form)类型的 schema 约束（properties/required/additionalProperties 被塞进描述文本）
signals.summary: jsonSchemaOutputFormat() 对 array-form 的 type 值只保留类型联合，却跳过其类型特定变换：可空对象的 properties、required、additionalProperties 被移动到 description 文本中而不再作为 schema 约束保留；可空数组/字符串也丢失了 item/minimum-length 和 format 约束。这导致结构化输出的 schema 约束被静默削弱，且已有确定的最小复现案例。
signals.review_reason: 依赖结构化输出且字段可空的用户在调用 jsonSchemaOutputFormat 时，其 schema 关键约束（必填、属性、additionalProperties、长度/format 限制）被静默丢弃，导致模型输出校验变弱或不符合预期约束。这属于关键功能（结构化输出）在特定类型下不可靠，属真实用户可见的功能缺陷。

source_issues.title: jsonSchemaOutputFormat drops constraints for array-form types (nullable objects)
source_issues.evidence: jsonSchemaOutputFormat() keeps array-form type values but skips their type-specific transformations. For a nullable object, properties, required, and additionalProperties are moved into description text instead of being retained as schema constraints. Nullable arrays and strings similarly lose supported item/minimum-length and format constraints.

signals.topic: 会话恢复在 git worktree 下静默丢失历史，且委托子代理后的后续控制响应被丢弃
signals.summary: SessionStore 的写入与读取对 project_key 的推导方式不一致，worktree 中的会话以 REPO 目录 list_sessions 或 resume 时被当作空，materialize_resume_session 返回 None 后静默开启全新会话，历史记录直接消失；另有 #1190：委托任务结束后 stdin 被提前关闭，后续 permission/hook 控制响应无法写入。
signals.review_reason: 两处都是会话生命周期缺陷：worktree 恢复时历史被静默丢弃（用户以为在续接旧会话实为从头开始），委托子代理后工具/权限控制响应可能被静默丢弃导致工具调用结果错乱，均为主流程关键功能不可用或数据丢失。

source_issues.title: Session store writes and reads derive project_key differently, so a git-worktree session lists and resumes as empty
source_issues.evidence: list_sessions_from_store(store, directory=REPO) 返回 []；materialize_resume_session 返回 None，ClaudeAgentOptions(resume=...) 静默开启全新会话，历史消失。

source_issues.title: stdin closes after a delegated task settles before Result, dropping a later continuation control response
source_issues.evidence: repro 输出 stdin_closed_before_late_control=True, late_control_response_delivered=False, late_response_write_after_close=True，late control 响应因 stdin 已关闭无法送达。

signals.topic: Host 端权限/交互控制面不完整：MCP 来源与决策字段丢失、对话框流报错且中断会杀死后台任务
signals.summary: can_use_tool 上下文丢失 mcp_server 来源、decision 等字段，且无法回传 decisionClassification/toolUseID，导致 Python host 无法实现 TypeScript 契约所描述的信任策略；elicitation/request_user_dialog 请求被直接以错误应答，且因未声明 perTaskStopAffordance，中断时会杀死后台任务。
signals.review_reason: 这是 host 集成层面的功能性缺陷：无法基于 MCP 来源实施信任策略意味着权限决策不可靠，对话框流完全不可用，且在中断场景后台任务会被静默杀死，影响关键运行期行为。

source_issues.title: can_use_tool: the permission request's MCP provenance and decision fields never reach the callback, and the result cannot carry decisionClassification or toolUseID
source_issues.evidence: can_use_tool 上下文仅有 8 个固定字段，mcp_server(nam(如 srv/project)、decision_reason_type 等均未传入，返回也无法带 decisionClassification/toolUseID，无法按 mcpServer.source 做信任决策。

source_issues.title: elicitation and request_user_dialog control requests are answered with an error; supportedDialogKinds and perTaskStopAffordance are never sent
source_issues.evidence: 初始化请求不发送 perTaskStopAffordance，按 TS 契约 host 中断时后台任务会被杀死；elicitation 请求被回 "Unsupported control request subtype: elicitation"。

signals.topic: SDK 选项被接受但静默未生效：跳过 MCP 发现失效导致连接重复、沙箱缺 failIfUnavailable 默认导致命令非沙箱运行
signals.summary: skipMcpDiscovery=True 的插件仍以 --plugin-dir 启动，MCP 发现未被跳过，host 的 MCP 连接被插件发现重复建立；sandbox.enabled=True 未补 failIfUnavailable 默认值，缺依赖（如 bubblewrap）时机上命令可能非沙箱运行，与 TypeScript SDK 行为不一致。
signals.review_reason: 用户显式设置的选项被静默忽略/不完整执行：跳过 MCP 发现被忽略会导致 MCP 连接重复、行为异常；沙箱缺少失败即报错的默认值会让本应受沙箱保护的命令在缺依赖时非沙箱运行，两者都与用户预期和跨 SDK 一致性冲突。

source_issues.title: SdkPluginConfig.skipMcpDiscovery is accepted by the type and ignored by the transport
source_issues.evidence: 运行时仅生成 --plugin-dir，无 --plugin-dir-no-mcp，skipMcpDiscovery 被静默忽略，插件 MCP 发现重复。

source_issues.title: sandbox settings are passed through without the failIfUnavailable default the TypeScript SDK applies
source_issues.evidence: sandbox 设置原样下发仅 {enabled:true}，缺 failIfUnavailable，缺依赖时命令可能回退到非沙箱执行，与 TS SDK 默认相反。

signals.topic: "always allow" 权限规则静默失效，用户被反复弹权限确认
signals.summary: can_use_tool 回调返回的 PermissionUpdate.to_dict() 对无内容的规则序列化为 "ruleContent": null，CLI 静默丢弃该更新且无任何报错，导致 "always allow"（如 WebSearch）永不生效，每次调用工具都再次触发权限确认。
signals.review_reason: 这是一个静默失效的权限功能缺陷：用户明确选择 always allow 后该选择不生效，工具被反复弹权限确认，主流程（连续工具调用）体验显著下降，且无错误提示让用户无从排查。

source_issues.title: PermissionUpdate.to_dict() sends "ruleContent": null; the CLI silently drops the update, so "always allow" never sticks for content-less rules
source_issues.evidence: 规则 ruleContent 为 null 时 prompt 次数为 2（每次都确认），改为省略该 key 后为 1；更新被 CLI 静默丢弃，无错误。需子类重写 to_dict 规避。

signals.topic: 顶配模型 claude-opus-5-5 无法使用：发布的 wheel 捆绑的 CLI 版本过旧，每轮调用 400
signals.summary: 最新发布的 claude-agent-sdk wheel 捆绑的 Claude Code CLI 只到 2.1.277，而 claude-opus-5-5 需要 CLI 2.1.280+。任何未指定自定义 cli_path 的用户设置 model="claude-opus-5-5" 都会在每一轮调用收到 400 错误。
aliases: 捆绑 CLI 版本滞后
signals.review_reason: 用户一旦启用新版全仓模型，主流程每一轮都被 400 阻断，且错误伪装成成功回合难以定位；这是发布流程（捆绑 CLI 版本滞后于模型要求）造成的关键功能不可用。

source_issues.title: No released SDK supports claude-opus-5-5: newest wheel (0.2.157) bundles CLI 2.1.277, model requires 2.1.280+
source_issues.evidence: 设置 model="claude-opus-5-5" 时每次调用返回 API Error 400，bundled CLI 2.1.277 < 所需 2.1.280；且 400 还伪装成 subtype=success，

signals.topic: createSdkMcpServer host-side tool calls fail for SDK consumers (subagent routing regression + zod 4.5 validation)
signals.summary: In-process SDK MCP server tool calls break for hosts: a 2.1.244-2.1.246 regression makes every Task-subagent call to a createSdkMcpServer() tool fail ~3ms in with 'tool call was interrupted'; separately, zod 4.5+ makes tool() calls that omit a .default() field fail validation with 'expected nonoptional' even though the JSON Schema marks the field optional. Both force entire MCP-based toolchains to degrade or be worked around.
signals.review_reason: Tool-call routing is the core path of this SDK; hosts that serve in-process MCP tools to Task subagents have their toolchain completely broken with real production evidence. The subagent regression is a clear user-facing break; the zod 4.5 validation issue is a separate incident affecting valid tool definitions. Both are distinct enough to arguably be separate topics, but as a combined createSdkMcpServer tool-calling pain point each has strong evidence.

source_issues.title: [Regression 2.1.244-2.1.246] SDK MCP (in-process) tool calls from Task subagents fail instantly: "tool call was interrupted before a result was received"
source_issues.evidence: Clean A/B bisection on identical production workload: 0.3.238-0.3.243 had hundreds of successful subagent-to-sdk-mcp calls; from 0.3.246 all 71 subagent calls over 6 days failed 100%, handler never invoked (~3ms gap), while main-agent calls to the same tools succeeded. Still broken through 0.3.251. Subagent runs produce degraded results.

signals.topic: CI 日志下载超时被误报为成功，Claude 读取空日志无法诊断任务失败原因
signals.summary: 当 GitHub CI job log 下载在 headers 到达后传输停滞或大日志超过 30s 仍在上传时，动作将 abort 视为空字符串，返回 size_bytes:0 的空日志作为成功。Claude 收到无报错的空日志，只知道 CI 失败却不知道原因。真实案例为 16.7MB 日志被截断为 0 字节，Claude 只能猜测失败原因。
signals.review_reason: 日志下载超时被静默吞掉并误报成功，直接导致 Claude 无法读取 CI 失败日志、无法诊断失败原因，是实际发生并被精心复现的关键功能/诊断信息不可用问题，属用户可感知的主流程诊断链路受损。

source_issues.title: download_job_log returns an empty log as success when its timeout fires mid-download
source_issues.evidence: 问题包含可复现的 repro 脚本与实际真实运行：16.7MB 日志经 30s 超时后写成 0 字节文件并返回 isError:false；'@octokit/request 9.2.4' abort 后返回空字符串，导致 Claude Code 读了空日志对失败原因一无所知（Claude 回复'Possible causes include the job still running, its logs having expired'）。超时本应返回 is_error:true 而未返回，主流程诊断信息丢失。

signals.topic: review 评论 diffHunk 无大小限制导致 prompt 越界，阻断该 PR 上所有 @claude 请求
signals.summary: 自 #1584 起 formatReviewComments 将每条内联评论的 diffHunk 无限制地拼入 prompt。新增大文件上大量评论会把整个文件 hunk 嵌进 prompt 数十次，实测一条 PR 达到约 3.0M 字符，远超上下文窗口，使该 PR 上每次 @claude 请求都以 'Prompt is too long' 结束且未发起任何 API 调用；用 /review 时甚至被误报为成功。
signals.review_reason: diffHunk 无限制把 prompt 撑爆，导致某类 PR（新增长文件 + 大量内联评论）上所有 @claude 请求 100% 失败、功能完全不可用，且 /review 路径还被误报为成功加剧了用户困惑，是阻断主流程的高影响痛点。

source_issues.title: "Prompt is too long": review comment diffHunk (#1584) is added to the prompt with no size limit
source_issues.evidence: 提供了可复现场景（tag-mode + 大文件 + 大量内联评论）与量化数据：70 条内联评论的 diffHunk 约 3.0M 字符，PR 上每次 @claude 均以 'Prompt is too long' 结束，duration_api_ms:0 total_cost_usd:0 从未调用 API；且 /review 下 is_error:false 被误报为成功，用户无从得知已失败。附 gh api 检测脚本与代码位置。

signals.topic: 动作间歇性以 is_error:true + subtype:success 提前约 15-25s 退出，未执行 review 却无失败原因暴露
signals.summary: 注释模式 /code-review 运行中，动作间歇性地在启动后约 15-25s 失败，claude-execution-output.json 报告 subtype:success 但 is_error:true，未产生任何 review（无 subagent、无 findings、无总结评论）。同一版本同一仓库部分运行成功部分失败，指向启动期/模型/传输的瞬时错误被错误地以也是成功态面向上层失败门禁，用户无法区分'从未执行'与'review 失败'。
signals.review_reason: 间歇性提前失败导致 review 门禁下的合法 PR 反复无法获得审查结论、需靠运气重试，同时错误地以成功态 subtype 呈现掩盖了真实启动错误，主流程 review 功能间歇性不可用且难以诊断。

source_issues.title: Action exits with subtype:success + is_error:true ~15-25s in, before reviewing (intermittent)
source_issues.evidence: 记录运行日志片段（'Claude result reported subtype success with is_error:true'、[error]Action failed with exit code 1），强调间歇性（同版本同仓库失败/成功并存，非配置破坏）、不涉及已知 tsconfig-override bug；影响是 fail-closed review 门禁下合法 PR 无法获得审查结论直到重试碰巧落干净，且无法区分启动失败与 review 失败。

signals.topic: 动作运行日志不可读，难以排查 Claude 实际执行与结果不符的问题
signals.summary: 动作日志输出大量 JSON 与无关信息，用户无法据此调试失败原因；例如日志认为 tsc 运行成功而实际上没有，用户无从了解 Claude 为何判定为成功。
signals.review_reason: 日志不可读使 Claude 的执行结果（如 tsc 是否真正成功）无法被用户核实，实际造成了错误感知与调试路径的不可用，属于体验与可观测性显著下降，但非主流程阻断，故为 P2。

source_issues.title: Claude code actions logs should be human readable and clearly show what commands Claude run and their output
source_issues.evidence: 用户描述日志充斥 JSON 和无关内容、根本无法调试失败原因，并举出实际现象：日志显示 tsc 运行成功但实际并非如此，用户无法解释 Claude 为何认为成功。这是对'日志不可读导致误判与无法排查'的明确用户影响描述。

signals.topic: Windows MSIX/Desktop install and auto-update leaves the app uninstallable, unable to relaunch, or on a broken stub
signals.summary: Windows MSIX installs fail with 0x80073CF9 (stray priconfig.xml / AddPackage failure), auto-update relaunch is blocked by a stale app container or git fsmonitor daemon (0x80070020), and incomplete npm releases ship a dead stub so the app will not start
signals.review_reason: Repeated install/update failures render Claude Code and Desktop unable to install, start, or relaunch on Windows, and broken npm releases strand users on dead stubs. These are main-flow blockers with high recurrence across many releases.
